thread:
Lina: Hey folks — quick onboarding question. Who owns routing policies (latency/cost-based routing vs region-based) and the model-variant fallbacks? Also who should I ping for Dedicated GPU pool access?

onboarding-bot: Hi Lina! Welcome 🎉. See onboarding checklist: <https://wiki.redwood.com/onboarding/week1>. For infra ownership questions, try #eng-platform or ping an owner below.

Ethan: @Lina for routing policy and model fallbacks the primary owners are eng-platform (routing rules) and eng-runtime (model variants). If you need to change routing for a customer, file a runbook request in the eng-platform board — here's the short path: https://boards.redwood.com/eng-platform/requests

Priya: For Dedicated GPU access requests, I handle those. Please run the access request command from the VPN and include these fields:
```
/request-dedicated-access --pool=pool-name --reason="prod test + service X" --manager=YourManager
```
I'll approve during my morning review if everything looks ok.

Lina: Thanks — is "pool-name" a literal or I should pick a specific one?

Priya: Pick the pool you were told in the onboarding doc (dedicated-gpu-1 or dev-gpu-2). If unsure, use dedicated-gpu-1 and put a note. If you need a bigger quota, mention it and I'll route to capacity-planning.

Lina: Cool. Also, who owns oncall for runtime incidents? If a model is slow or we get p99 spikes who do I alert?

Marta: Runtime incidents are dual-owned: eng-runtime owns model-serving faults, eng-sre owns infra and network. PagerDuty rules: page @eng-oncall first (priority), then page @eng-sre if infra is implicated. If it's a customer-impacting regression, escalate to SRE manager and the product oncall.

SRE-ops-bot: Incident playbooks: <https://playbooks.redwood.com/runtime-p99>. Oncall rota: https://rota.redwood.com/eng-oncall

Ethan: Adding that for ownership questions inside a ticket, set labels: team=eng-runtime or team=eng-platform and severity=sevX. Those tags help routing and fast triage.

Lina: Super helpful, thanks! One last thing — who should I copy on changes to alert thresholds?

Marta: Copy @eng-sre (alerts channel) and @eng-runtime. Small threshold tweaks can be done with a PR in infra-alerts repo; major changes need a quick sync meeting.

Lina: Got it. I'll open the access request now and ping Priya if anything blocks. Thanks everyone :heart:

Priya: Welcome again — ping me if the command errors out or you need a fast approve.

Ethan: And if you want a quick walkthrough of routing rules, happy to do a 15-min call this week.

Lina: Would love that — sending availability.
